titleEn: Sorry. Let Us Build It Again!

pages.text: Crash! Nono, the smallest, roundest sparrow, slipped while holding a snow shovel. The snow tower collapsed. "Oh, no!" He froze where he had fallen.
Kiki, the pointy-eared cat, let the tail droop. "I worked on it all morning..." Nono's cheeks burned. He wanted to say sorry, but his beak would not open.
Head down, Nono backed toward the wall. Kiki gathered fallen snow alone. Gugu, the broad-chested pigeon, looked from one to the other.
By the wall, Nono stared at his toes. The tower's place stood empty. His green scarf slipped forward, but he left it.
Before finishing the tower, Kiki went toward the shop. One snowball lay on the broom marks. Nono stared at it a long time.
Gugu came over. "Nono, Kiki is still outside the shop." Gugu patted his back.
Nono crunched over to Kiki and looked up, meeting Kiki's eyes. "Kiki, I am sorry I knocked your tower down. Let us build it again!"
Grandpa brought a shovel heaped with clean white snow. Without a word, he poured it before them.
They built together: Nono on top, Kiki at the sides, Gugu at the bottom. "One, stop your feet! Two, look at their face and say sorry! Three, try again together!" The tower grew taller than before.
Kiki hugged Nono. Say sorry first, and you can play together again. Nono touched his green scarf. "Sorry. Let us build it again!"
